title: Code & Architecture Audit
description: Deep-dive review of your codebase, architecture decisions, and tech debt surface. Delivered as a prioritized remediation roadmap with estimated effort.

title: Technical Advisory
description: Ongoing advisory engagement — architecture reviews, RFC feedback, tech selection, and mentoring for your senior engineers. 4h/week minimum.

title: Feature Delivery
description: End-to-end delivery of critical features — from RFC through implementation, testing, and deployment. You define the scope, I ship it.

title: Interim Tech Lead
description: Step into your team as acting Tech Lead/Engineering Manager for 3–6 months. Run standups, unblock engineers, own delivery.
